import sys

class Task:
    def can(self, n: int, m: int, depth: int) -> bool:
        if depth == 0:
            return True
        d = m % n
        q = m // n
        if d <= 1:
            return self.can(n, q, depth - 1)
        if d == n or d == n - 1:
            return self.can(n, q + 1, depth - 1)
        return False

    def solve(self, test_number: int, sc, pw) -> None:
        n = int(sc.readline().strip())
        m = int(sc.readline().strip())
        pw.write("YES\n" if self.can(n, m, 30) else "NO\n")

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    task = Task()
    pw = sys.stdout
    pw.write("YES\n" if task.can(n, m, 30) else "NO\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
